newsitem.title: USA: BT Financial sets 10 pct stock dividend.
newsitem.headline: BT Financial sets 10 pct stock dividend.

text.p: BT Financial Corp said Wednesday it would pay a 10-percent stock dividend on September 15 to shareholders of record on August 27.
The company also declared a cash dividend of $0.34 a share to shareholders of record on August 8, 1997, payable September 2 1997.

The bank holding company Wednesday reported a $4.2 million net income, or $0.74 per share, in the second quarter compared with a net of $3.0 million, or $0.54 a share, last year. The bank's assets grew 3.3 percent to $1.55 billion as of June 30 from $1.50 billion the year before.
The bank's earnings fell just short of a First Call poll of two analysts, who had put the bank's second-quarter results at $0.75 a share.
The bank's stock nevertheless hit a 52-week high of 46-1/2 Wednesday afternoon, up 3/8.
